parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module src/business/services fails the coherence and boundary rubric because src/business/services/CycleCountService.ts bypasses the persistence and domain abstractions used in src/business/services/ReceivingService.ts. While ReceivingService accesses persistence exclusively through table repositories (ItemTable, BinTable) and enforces rules through domain entities (Bin, Item, StockError), CycleCountService reaches persistence directly through the ORM client: CycleCountService.count calls this.prisma.stockCount.create on an injected PrismaService, and CycleCountService.openDiscrepancies instantiates a raw PrismaClient from @prisma/client to call prisma.stockCount.findMany(), bypassing even its own injected PrismaService. Additionally, CycleCountService duplicates the discrepancy rule (counted !== expected and delta: counted - expected) across count and openDiscrepancies.
